name: prepare_price_embedded_scale_labels
query: alter table public.products add column if not exists scale_plu integer; alter table public.products drop constraint if exists products_scale_plu_range; alter table public.products add constraint products_scale_plu_range check (scale_plu is null or scale_plu between 1 and 999999); create unique index if not exists products_scale_plu_unique_idx on public.products(scale_plu) where scale_plu is not null; create table if not exists public.scale_barcode_settings (id smallint primary key default 1 check (id = 1), enabled boolean not null default false, prefix text not null default '20' check (prefix ~ '^[0-9]{2,4}$'), plu_digits smallint not null default 5 check (plu_digits between 3 and 6), amount_digits smallint not null default 5 check (amount_digits between 4 and 6), amount_kind text not null default 'total_price' check (amount_kind = 'total_price'), includes_check_digit boolean not null default true, updated_at timestamptz not null default now()); insert into public.scale_barcode_settings (id, enabled, prefix, plu_digits, amount_digits, amount_kind, includes_check_digit) values (1, false, '20', 5, 5, 'total_price', true) on conflict (id) do nothing; alter table public.scale_barcode_settings enable row level security; revoke all on table public.scale_barcode_settings from anon, authenticated;
